about_pullquote: I got into this business because I was tired of watching overpriced cowboys rip people off.
about_para_1: David Electrical was founded on the principle that honest, fast electrical work shouldn't cost the earth. For over 18 years, we've built our reputation in Bristol by turning up on time, diagnosing faults properly, and charging fairly. Every engineer carries full qualifications and the right parts — no return visits, no hidden extras.
about_para_2: Our customers return because we listen, explain the work clearly, and leave the job clean and safe. We hold full NICEIC certification and offer a 12-month parts and labour guarantee on everything we do. Whether you need an emergency callout at 2am or a planned rewire, we treat your home with the same care we'd give our own.
reviews_heading: What Bristol Homeowners Say About David Electrical

reviews.text: Had a complete nightmare with a faulty consumer unit that nearly caused a fire. David came out the same evening, sorted it quickly, and explained everything as he went. Charged a fair price too. Can't recommend highly enough.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Needed an emergency call after our electrics went down just before Christmas. David answered straight away, arrived within 45 minutes, and had us back online by dinner time. Proper professional. Will use again for our rewire next year.
reviews.author: Jennifer P.

reviews.text: Rewired our 1970s semi completely. The work was spotless, certified, and David's team cleaned up every day. They explained what was old and dangerous, what needed doing, and didn't try to upsell us. Worth every penny.
reviews.author: Robert K.
